# Potluck fixtures

`kinds/apinata/seed/opencollection.yml` is copied unchanged from
[PhongGuy/potluck](https://github.com/PhongGuy/potluck) at commit `4776963`,
path `crates/potluck/src/kinds/apinata/seed/opencollection.yml`. It is the
root file of a new team workspace of kind `apinata`, and Apinata's writer must
reproduce it byte for byte.
